title: Process-Aware Event Log Augmentation for Process Prediction under Labeled Data Scarcity
abstract: arXiv:2610.24777v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts future events of ongoing business processes based on event logs. However, deep learning PPM approaches are often limited by labeled data scarcity and the low variability of real-world logs. To address this, we introduce SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with statistically grounded data augmentation. It employs novel transformation methods that leverage control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to generate realistic, semantically valid trace variants, learning generalizable prefix representations without labeled supervision. Extensive experiments on real-world event logs with a wide range of variability, incorporating exhaustive hyperparameter tuning, demonstrate the value of this process-aware augmentation. translated_title: 标注数据稀缺下面向过程预测的过程感知事件日志增强
translated_abstract: 预测性过程监控（PPM）基于事件日志对正在进行的业务过程的未来事件进行预测。然而，深度学习PPM方法往往受限于标注数据的稀缺性以及真实世界日志的低变异性。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了SiamSA-PPM，这是一个将孪生学习与基于统计的数据增强相结合的自监督框架。该框架采用新颖的变换方法，利用控制流语义和频繁行为模式来生成逼真的、语义有效的轨迹变体，从而在无需标注监督的情况下学习可泛化的前缀表示。在具有广泛变异性的真实世界事件日志上进行了大量实验，并结合详尽的超参数调优，结果证明了这种过程感知增强方法的价值。与最先进的基线方法相比，SiamSA-PPM在下一活动预测和最终结果预测方面均取得了具有竞争力或更优的预测性能。
tldr: 该论文提出SiamSA-PPM自监督框架，将孪生学习与利用控制流语义和频繁行为模式的过程感知数据增强相结合，以解决预测性过程监控中标注数据稀缺和日志变异性低的问题，在下一活动和最终结果预测上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with process-aware data augmentation that leverages control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to address labeled data scarcity in Predictive Process Monitoring, achieving competitive or superior performance in next activity and final outcome prediction.
